pr.title: Announce only the review work that stands on a pull request's current head
pr.head: 7dd2beabc773b0ebebdb708a889b601a36c9d666

summary: The watch daemon is the one background process per machine that polls the pull requests agent sessions subscribe to. It writes one line per event, such as FINDING or REVIEW, and Projector's Claude Code mod submits each line to the session as a prompt. Every line therefore wakes an agent.

Before this change, the session that owns a pull request's fix role, the session that runs fix-pr on it, heard two kinds of line that asked nothing of it. The first pass over a pull request announced a REVIEW line for every comment review the pull request ever had, on every head, each ending "run fix-pr". A draft also produced a DRAFT line, repeated every 15 minutes, even while another session was reviewing it.

• REVIEW reports another reviewer's comment review only on the current head. It reports a Projector review only while its suggestions stand, as project review suggestions decides: the newest verdict on the current head by each account and model, plus the full review an incremental one builds on, which can be of an earlier head. Each review is announced once.
  • DRAFT reports only a draft that no session on this machine reviews, and only once per head.
FINDING, VERDICT, and CONFLICT still report standing work from any head and still repeat every watch.renotify seconds. The review-role events, NEW PR, NEW HEAD, RESPONDED, and MOVED, do not change.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html:
• The Projector review of 15125fd found that an incremental review's carried suggestions were never announced. 7dd2bea fixes it by reusing suggesting_reviews, and the thread is resolved.
  • The Projector review of 7dd2bea is clean, and the full validation gate passes at this head.

cards.title: Terms
cards.html:
• Role: the daemon's assignment of a pull request to one session, fix for the session that fixes it and review <model> for each reviewing model.
  • Incremental review: a short clean verdict on a new head that builds on a review loop's last full review and lists no suggestions of its own.
  • Suggestion: a P3 item a Projector review lists in its body, which fix-pr implements or defers.

groups.title: The fix role hears only current-head work
groups.kicker: Two filters in route_fix, the suggestion lookup they share with the CLI, and their tests
intro: route_fix in watch.py builds the lines a fix owner hears on each pass. It calls standing once per piece of work, keyed so that each key is announced when it first appears and, when the call passes a reminder, again after watch.renotify seconds.
The DRAFT call now runs only when no session owns a review role for the pull request, and passes no reminder. Its key includes the head, so a push announces the draft again.

For reviews, the new standing_suggestions asks review.suggesting_reviews which Projector reviews' suggestions stand on the head, the same lookup project review suggestions runs, over the reviews review.counted_reviews lets give a verdict. A Projector review is reported only when it is among them and lists at least one. Any other review is reported only on the current head. route_fix keeps every announced review: key, so a full review is not announced again when the next head's incremental review carries it forward.

checks.text: Reran the earlier finding's reproductions against this head with the fake gh. A fixer that gains the role at an incremental head hears the full review's 2 suggestions. A push that lands before the full review is announced holds the line until the incremental review lands, then announces it once. A review an earlier release wrote without a count line is reported with 1 suggestion.
A fixer that heard the full review at head A hears nothing more when the incremental review of head B lands.

files.note: The narrowed DRAFT condition, standing_suggestions, the rewritten REVIEW loop, and trim_review keeping html_url, which an incremental review's link names.

checks.text: A daemon cache written before this change has no html_url, so an incremental review's link matches nothing until the next full pass reads the reviews again, every watch.full_every seconds.

files.note: Splits the filter out of verdicts as counted_reviews, so the daemon can apply it to the reviews in its cache. It now also refuses to match an empty reviewer login.
Adds projector_body and richer rest_review fixtures, and tests for carried suggestions, announcing them once across heads, earlier-release reviews, and which accounts' reviews count.

groups.title: The docs and fix-pr describe the new rules
groups.kicker: The CLI event table, fix-pr's event notes, and the plan's record
intro: Three documents describe the events. docs/cli.md holds the reference table, skills/fix-pr/SKILL.md tells a fixing agent how to act on each event, and the watch-daemon plan records decisions made while building the daemon in § 9.1.

checks.text: All three now say a REVIEW reports any other reviewer's body on the current head, including a bot's, such as Codex's.

files.note: The REVIEW and DRAFT rows, and DRAFT leaves the list of events that repeat.
The REVIEW and DRAFT notes, and DRAFT leaves the list of reminders. It drops the note about reviews an earlier release published, which the daemon no longer reports.
A new bullet at the end of § 9.1, "Only work wakes a session". The plan stays in-progress, and no section is renumbered.
